page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre with page number 5 at top right. Main text in one column. Marginal note numbers at right edge (3). Left margin holds cropped fragments of another page's text (not transcribed). Signature A 3 at foot, catchword "con-" at right.

main_text.l: Suarez. Rectius videtur eam rem tractasse
errores, comiter excepisse, in honore ha-
buisse, & ut in Ecclesia preces funderent,
quòd id ante causam cognitam fas non
in primitiva Ecclesia fuisse dictam, quando
esse profitentes ad communes tantùm Ec-
esse Catholicos fide certâ docuissent. Atq;
2. Dicitur in Ecclesiis nostris Cœna Do-
unum, jam non est Dominicam Cœnam
manducare. De quo loco August. Epist. 118.
bus ergò vobis in unum, non est Domini-
cam cœnam manducare: hanc ipsam ac-
œnam vocans. Et esse communem Patrum

page.notes: Left margin fragments are from the facing page and are not transcribed. Marginal number 3 at right is a section mark. Some words in the body are uncertain due to scan quality, notably "Chrysostomum", "impertiebantur" and "Sozomenum"; these are copied as best read.
